about: Card data fixes from the website's Edit button. Keyed by card file name; each field overrides the PSD. _site: the card-image fields that are website only (never baked into the card image). _rename: true beside a name: the bake also renames the card's files to it. art, ability_art: where the card's main and ability artwork come from (a URL, an artist, a game; at most 500 characters), each entry its own, duplicates too. Read by the website and the card sync.
